description: Selective Path 3 semantic RMSNorm native-lowering promotion. On NV sm_120 only the 4096-wide attention, FFN, and output norm sites are admitted; Q/K head norms retain their fused reduce-output plus RoPE/cache route. The qualified attention completion preserves all 17 shared-Q8 norm/provider bodies while replacing the remaining 19 legacy attention reduce-output bodies. Its 2026-08-26 candidate/control/candidate d512 bracket recovered 62.995 us/token with identical hashes across 432 timed tokens and reached a 4.156064 ms midpoint (240.612 tok/s). TINYGRAD_NATIVE_ATTN_NORM_COMPLETION_DISABLE=1 restores the 19 legacy bodies. The independent Q/K native bracket lost 1.792 us/token, so target admission remains site-filtered.
